summary: Frontend-only verification of Flint static site (iteration 2). PRIMARY BUG FIX VERIFIED: After reloading /window.html (with SW already active), window.$scramjetLoadController is typeof 'function', no 'does not allow Service Workers' banner, no '$scramjetLoadController is not defined' text, #address-bar exists, tab bar + nav buttons (#tabs-container, #back-btn, #fwd-btn, #reload-btn, #home-btn-nav, #devtools-btn, #wisp-settings-btn) render, and navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().length == 1. Engine assets serve correctly with proper MIME types (/engine/scramjet.all.js and scramjet.sync.js as application/javascript, /engine/scramjet.wasm.wasm as application/wasm, all 200). Landing / returns 200 with <title>Flint</title>. Data pages populate: g.html (65 game tiles), a.html (10 apps), vm.html (Ubuntu + Windows XP), nt.html quotes render (e.g., 'Stopping SlowGuardian'). Welcome modal on nt.html correctly reads 'Welcome! Search the web or jump into games, apps, AI and more.' No visible 'Discord' text/button/shortcut tile on nt.html. Third-party wisp websocket errors observed (counter.leelive2021, glseries.net) are expected per test note (external servers unreachable) and did NOT affect in-scope checks.

issues: Dead CSS leftover after Discord removal: <style> block still contains '--discord: #5865F2;' CSS variable and orphan '.discord-btn' rules. Not rendered anywhere (no visible Discord text, button, or shortcut tile), but 4 case-insensitive 'discord' string matches exist inside the <style> tag's text content. If strict interpretation of 'no discord text anywhere in the DOM' is required, remove the unused CSS variable and .discord-btn ruleset from pages/nt.html <style>.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: remove unused '--discord' CSS variable and orphan '.discord-btn' style rules from frontend/public/pages/nt.html <style> block (no visible impact, cosmetic dead code).
critical_code_review_comments: Primary reported bug ('$scramjetLoadController is not defined' after reload) is fully resolved by moving engine files to /engine/ outside the /scramjet/ SW virtual prefix. Post-reload assertions all pass. Engine MIME types are correct.
Dead CSS references to Discord remain in nt.html — non-functional but should be pruned for hygiene.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The critical repro is: navigate to /window.html, wait ~4s for SW to install, then page.reload() and wait ~5s. Check typeof window.$scramjetLoadController === 'function' and navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().length >= 1. Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (particles/background network keeps 'networkidle' from ever firing). Discord removal check should scope to visible DOM text (document.body.innerText) — nt.html body innerText contains no 'discord'; only <style> block CSS variables/rulesets do. The apps page (/pages/a.html) legitimately shows a 'Discord' app tile from apps.json (out of scope for the removal requirement which targeted nt.html only).
